title: Canonical model maps commute with localized comparison
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in universe u with R-algebras A,B and an E=A tensor_R B-algebra C. Assume derived categories of R- and B-modules. Universal base-derived tensor cohomology models are as in [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Let f:Q to Q' be an A-linear chain map, m,n models of Q,Q', and i an integer. Let δ:m.derived to n.derived be a counit-compatible natural transformation. Let g:m.cohomology(i) to n.cohomology(i) be an E-linear map whose restriction to B, after the cohomology identifications, is H^i(m.derived(f)) followed by H^i(δ at restricted Q'). Then extension of g from E to C followed by n.localizedComparison(i) equals m.localizedComparison(i) followed by degree-i homology of termwise extension of f from A to C along A to E to C. No flatness assumption or invertibility of f or g is required.

proof.text: Prove naturality of ordinaryIso on pure tensors using ordinaryIso_tmul and ExtendScalars.map_tmul. Restrict g to B and compose the desired ordinary comparison equation with mapHomologyIso.inv. Use comparison_eq, the prescribed equation for g, counit compatibility, and naturality of the counit. Naturality of the derived and homotopy homology-factor isomorphisms, and of restriction mapHomologyIso, reduces the equation to the ordinaryIso naturality square just proved. Faithful restriction proves the ordinary E-linear comparison square.

Prove naturality of ordinaryToLocalized by its value on pure tensors. Transpose the localized equation through the extension/restriction adjunction. Its homEquiv naturality and both localized_eq identities reduce the equation to the ordinary comparison square, the ordinaryToLocalized square and naturality of mapHomologyIso. Use homologyMap_comp and associativity to close the equation; injectivity of homEquiv completes the proof. These equations hold for zero rings and zero complexes and require no coproduct or flatness hypothesis.

lean.statement:
theorem baseDerivedTensorCohomologyMap_localized_naturality
    (Q Q' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (f : Q ⟶ Q')
    (m : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q C)
    (n : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q' C) (i : ℤ)
    (δ : m.derived ⟶ n.derived) (g : m.cohomology i ⟶ n.cohomology i)
    (hδ : Functor.whiskerLeft (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := ModuleCat.{u} R)) δ ≫
      n.counit = m.counit)
    (hg : (restrictScalars.{u}
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B).toRingHom).map g ≫
          (n.cohomologyIso i).hom =
      (m.cohomologyIso i).hom ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
          (m.derived.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).map
              (((restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map f)))) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
          (δ.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).obj
              (((restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q'))))) :
    (extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C)).map g ≫ n.localizedComparison i =
      m.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (((extendScalars.{u, u, u}
          ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).map f) i
